data.title: Heavy rain forecast over most of Thailand
data.description: The Meteorological Department forecast is for heavy rain in western parts of the North, the Central Plain, the upper and eastern parts of the Northeast and the East from Sunday to Wednesday.

data.title: Counterfeit goods cost the economy B809m in seven months
data.description: <p>Intellectual property violations caused more than 809 million baht in economic losses in the first seven months of this year, the Department of Intellectual Property said yesterday.</p>

data.title: Pattaya art festival now live
data.description: CHON BURI: Pattaya has launched its first sand art festival, combining sculptures, light, sound and technology to create a new landmark for tourists.

data.title: Phuket beach site ordered cleared
data.description: PHUKET: Thalang district has enforced a Supreme Court ruling over more than five rai of disputed land at Bang Tao beach, where 16 restaurants were built.

data.title: Locals eye Mon Bridge repair
data.description: KANCHANABURI: Sangkhlaburi district is planning a major repair of the Mon Bridge after heavy rain damaged parts of the structure. The work is expected to cost 40-50 million baht.

data.title: Skywalk to complete Victory Monument loop in October
data.description: <p>Bangkok will open the first phase of the Rajavithi Skywalk in early October, linking BTS Victory Monument station with existing walkways around the landmark.</p>

data.title: NE faces drought as South braces for floods
data.description: <p>A prolonged dry spell linked to the incoming "super El Ni&ntilde;o" is reducing water supplies in Nakhon Ratchasima province, as Songkhla province in the South prepares for possible flooding.</p>

data.title: Security net changes spur fears
data.description: <p>Three key economic agencies have urged the Labour Ministry to review plans to extend Section 33 of the Social Security Act to additional categories of workers, citing concerns over the financial impact on workers, employers and the state.</p>

data.title: Pressure rises on EC over probe
data.description: <p>The Election Commission (EC) is facing a credibility test as it schedules a vote on the Senate collusion case for Sept 14. Opposition figures warn that this decision could reshape the political system.</p>

data.title: Insurgency 'renewing itself'
data.description: <p>The latest unrest in the southern border provinces shows an insurgency adapting faster than the state's response, demanding a strategy beyond military containment.</p>

data.title: Covid-19 infections, deaths on rise
data.description: <p>The number of Covid-19 cases has risen in recent months, with 95,357 infections and 14 deaths recorded from Jan 1 to Friday.</p>

data.title: Widow of man who died in 2024 turbulence sues airline
data.description: A British woman whose husband died after severe turbulence that forced a Singapore Airlines flight to make an emergency landing in Bangkok two years ago has begun legal action against the airline.

data.title: Fire-hit Klongthom Center can’t be saved, says Chadchart
data.description: Fire broke out again on Saturday afternoon at Klongthom Center in Bangkok, after a major blaze overnight caused extensive damage to the popular market for second-hand goods, electronics, spare parts and tools.

data.title: Forum warned about ‘takeover’ of country
data.description: People’s Party leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has warned that alleged irregularities in the 2024 Senate election were the starting point of an attempt to gain control of the country.

data.title: Work at Klongthom Center fire scene continues
data.description: Heat and combustible materials continued to pose risks inside the partly collapsed Klongthom Center building in Bangkok on Saturday after a massive fire on Friday night, with the blaze largely under control but officials warning of potentially toxic smoke.

data.title: Next stage of budget bill debate set for Sept 7-9
data.description: <p>The House of Representatives is expected to consider the 2027 fiscal budget bill in its second and third readings from Sept 7-9, according to the special committee scrutinising the bill.</p>

data.title: Huai Khwang pub raided, nominee structure suspected
data.description: A pub in Huai Khwang district of Bangkok was found to have reopened without a proper licence after previously being ordered to close, with authorities also suspecting a nominee ownership arrangement.

data.title: Bangkok launches new campaign to help homeless
data.description: <p>The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) has launched a multi-agency operation to connect homeless people on Rattanakosin Island with shelter, healthcare and social services.</p>

data.title: Police say government job-sale probe likely to reach top brass
data.description: <p>Police are expanding their investigation into an alleged network accused of selling positions in local government agencies, with investigators confident the probe will lead to senior officials being implicated, a Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) deputy commissioner said yesterday.</p>

data.title: People’s Party faces its big test
data.description: <p>The opposition is preparing for what it hopes will be the most consequential parliamentary challenge yet to Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul&rsquo;s administration.</p>
